rows.currentScript: Line up the two clues. Finn outruns Isla, and Isla in turn outruns Ben. That drops Ben right to the back. Flip a clue and you slide to the front.
rows.whyRewrite: Last sentence is false and unclear: "Flip a clue and you slide to the front." Flipping "Isla outruns Ben" gives Isla as slowest (the clue-flip option), not anyone at the front; and "you" do not slide anywhere.

rows.currentScript: Read the clues side by side. Jack tops Cara, and Cara in turn tops Finn. That puts Finn at the bottom. Jack and Cara both rise taller.
rows.whyRewrite: Last sentence "Jack and Cara both rise taller." has no comparison (taller than whom?) and an odd verb a child will stumble on; with "tops" for taller the script never states the height relation plainly.
